name: India
gaps: Bihar: only lead found was a Nalanda nature walk group whose own blog now redirects to a generic WordPress.com landing page, so no live link could be confirmed.

Chhattisgarh: a biodiversity research group was mentioned in a national directory but its own site could not be read well enough to confirm it is a volunteer group rather than a guided trail business, so it was left out rather than guessed at.
Haryana: Bird Count India's own events page states it has received no reports of organised bird walks in Haryana, and no standalone club or page could be found for Gurgaon or Faridabad.
Himachal Pradesh: the one dedicated resource, the Himachal Birds blog, has had no posts since around 2017 and reads as dormant, so it was left out under the three year activity rule.
Jharkhand: a Facebook group called Birds of Jharkhand exists but no search result quoted its member count, bio or a real post, so it could not be verified to the required standard.
Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura: no state level bird club or verifiable public group page could be found for any of these six states.
Punjab: birding activity around Amritsar and Ludhiana is real but no dedicated club or page distinct from the Chandigarh Bird Club could be confirmed.
Puducherry: an informal WhatsApp based bird walk group was mentioned in a national directory but has no public link to verify.
Andaman and Nicobar Islands: no birding club or public group could be found; birding there appears to run through tour operators and the forest department rather than a community group.

Dropped on a browser check 2026-08-09: UP Birds (Uttar Pradesh): could not be corroborated: no search result quotes its real content; Odisha Nature and Wildlife (Odisha): dead, Facebook serves "content isn't available"

groups.name: Bombay Natural History Society
groups.blurb: India's premier ornithological research organization since 1883. BirdLife International partner.

groups.name: Wildlife Trust of India
groups.blurb: National conservation organization working on species recovery, protected areas, and wildlife rescue across India.

groups.name: Bird Count India
groups.blurb: National citizen science collective coordinating bird atlases, counts and monitoring projects across every state.

groups.name: Bird Alliance
groups.blurb: Nationwide collective connecting birders, educators and researchers, with a directory of local groups across India.

groups.name: SACON (Salim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History)
groups.blurb: National research institute for ornithology and conservation science. Conducts bird research, maintains ornithological databank.

groups.name: Madras Naturalists' Society
groups.blurb: Chennai naturalist society since 1978, running nature walks, talks and long running bird surveys.

groups.name: Tamilbirds
groups.blurb: Long running discussion group for Tamil Nadu birders, sharing sightings, identification help and trip reports.

groups.name: Salem Ornithological Foundation
groups.blurb: Salem based foundation studying and conserving birds across the surrounding landscapes of Tamil Nadu.

groups.name: Endangered Wildlife and Environmental Trust

groups.name: Bird Atlas Delhi

groups.name: delhibird Foundation
groups.blurb: Delhi's long running birdwatching network, running Sunday bird walks and citizen science projects across the city.

groups.name: Delhi Bird Photographers Meetup

groups.name: BlrBirders (Birdwatchers' Field Club of Bangalore)

groups.name: Kaiga Birders

groups.name: Deccan Birders

groups.name: Vizag Birders

groups.name: Malabar Natural History Society

groups.name: Cochin Natural History Society

groups.name: Bird Diversity Kerala

groups.name: Nature Mates

groups.name: Birdwatchers' Society

groups.name: Goa Bird Conservation Network

groups.name: Maharashtra Pakshimitra

groups.name: Mumbai Birdwatchers Club
